en.question: Is Tali only for wine and cigars?
en.answer: No. Tali monitors and guards anything that demands a precise environment — art, instruments, rare books, medicines and other perishables. If it suffers from environmental  variations, Tali can monitor and guard it.

es.question: ¿Tali es solo para vinos y puros?
es.answer: No. Tali vigila y cuida cualquier cosa que exija un ambiente preciso — arte, instrumentos, libros raros, medicinas y otros perecederos. Si sufre con las variaciones del ambiente, Tali puede vigilarlo y cuidarlo.
